run_http_test_server: run the HTTP test server on a specified port with optional SSL support
run_handler_do_GET: run the Handler do_GET method to respond to GET requests on the /get path
run_handler_do_POST: run the Handler do_POST method to respond to POST requests on the /post path with hello body
review_handler_good: review the Handler good method that sends a 200 OK HTML response with hello world content
test_ssl_server: test the HTTP server with SSL enabled using the server1.pem and server1.key credentials
